-- Monthly Revenue Trend for Year 1997
SELECT dd.year, dd.month_number, dd.month_name,
       SUM(fs.revenue) AS total_revenue,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fs.order_key) AS total_orders
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.order_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.year = 1997
GROUP BY dd.year, dd.month_number, dd.month_name
ORDER BY dd.month_number;

-- Top 10 Customers by Total Profit with Market Segment
SELECT dc.customer_key, dc.customer_name, dc.market_segment,
       SUM(fs.profit) AS total_profit,
       SUM(fs.revenue) AS total_revenue,
       SUM(fs.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_customer dc ON fs.customer_key = dc.customer_key
GROUP BY dc.customer_key, dc.customer_name, dc.market_segment
ORDER BY total_profit DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Supplier Performance: Parts Supplied vs. Revenue by Nation
SELECT ds.nation_name, ds.region_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fs.part_key) AS unique_parts_supplied,
       SUM(fs.quantity) AS total_quantity_shipped,
       SUM(fs.revenue) AS total_revenue,
       SUM(fs.profit) AS total_profit,
       COUNT(DISTINCT fs.supplier_key) AS active_suppliers
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_supplier ds ON fs.supplier_key = ds.supplier_key
GROUP BY ds.nation_name, ds.region_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

-- Part Brand Profitability Analysis (High Volume Brands)
WITH brand_stats AS (
    SELECT dp.brand,
           SUM(fs.quantity) AS total_qty,
           SUM(fs.revenue) AS total_rev,
           SUM(fs.profit) AS total_profit,
           AVG(fs.discount) AS avg_discount
    FROM fact_sales fs
    JOIN dim_part dp ON fs.part_key = dp.part_key
    GROUP BY dp.brand
    HAVING SUM(fs.quantity) > 100000
)
SELECT brand, total_qty, total_rev, total_profit,
       ROUND(total_profit / NULLIF(total_rev, 0) * 100, 2) AS profit_margin_pct,
       ROUND(avg_discount * 100, 2) AS avg_discount_pct
FROM brand_stats
ORDER BY profit_margin_pct DESC;

-- Late Shipment Analysis by Ship Mode and Year
SELECT dd.year, fs.ship_mode,
       COUNT(*) AS total_lineitems,
       SUM(CASE WHEN fs.ship_date_key > fs.commit_date_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_shipments,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fs.ship_date_key > fs.commit_date_key THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_pct,
       AVG(fs.ship_date_key - fs.commit_date_key) AS avg_days_late
FROM fact_sales fs
JOIN dim_date dd ON fs.ship_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE fs.commit_date_key IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dd.year, fs.ship_mode
ORDER BY dd.year, late_pct DESC;
